title: After Dark Desert Tour and Navigating the Night Sky
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: My Arizona Guide stargazing enthusiasts have designed the perfect all ages family sunset eco-tour. We bring together basic astronomy and the ancient navigation traditions of the indigenous peoples of Arizona with an opportunity to also see what kind of nighttime creatures and activity we can find. We can also bring some desert creatures for a fun learning experience. You will also learn about the plants and animals of this unique ecosystem.
